HCG Vortex is an advanced Home Screen animation engine featuring directional overrides, customizable transitions, and modular animation effects.

Your swipe still navigates exactly as iOS intends — Vortex only changes how the transition *looks*.

**Effects**
- Reverse Slide — the transition moves opposite to your swipe
- Vertical Rise — the next page rises from below
- Vertical Fall — the next page drops in from above
- Custom Directions — 8-way matrix, independent incoming and outgoing directions

**Controls**: per-swipe effects, reverse, duration, speed, intensity, easing, fade.

No network access, analytics or telemetry. Free.
_Screenshots will be added after on-device verification._

- First alpha: Reverse Slide, Vertical Rise, Vertical Fall, Custom Directions
- Per-swipe effects, duration, speed, intensity, easing, fade
- Settings pane with engine diagnostics
- Runtime compatibility gate, kill switch, master switch

**Install**: add the HCG Repo, install HCG Vortex, respring. Open Settings → HCG Vortex and check that Engine Status reads *Active*.

**Turn off**: Settings → HCG Vortex → Enable Vortex (instant).

**Uninstall**: remove the package in Sileo/Zebra and respring.

**If SpringBoard won't start**: use safe mode or disable tweak injection in the Dopamine app, then remove the package. Over SSH: `touch /var/mobile/Library/Preferences/com.hakmicapitalgroup.vortex.disabled` and respring to load nothing.
